author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿನ ಒಳಗೆ ಅವಿತಿರುವ ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳ ನೀನರಿಯೆ
ಅನವರತ ತಡೆಯುತಿಹ ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಗೆಲ್ಲು
ಮನ ತನುವು ತಾಳೆಯಿರೆ ಶಕ್ತಿಸಂಚಯವಾಗೆ
ನಿನತನವು ಉಜ್ವಲವು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: You do not know the powers hidden within you;
conquer the enemies that keep holding you back;
when mind and body move in rhythm, strength gathers,
and your own true self shines bright, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: There is more strength in us than we realise. Overcome the inner enemies that hold you back, bring mind and body into harmony, and your true nature will shine.
